categories.label: Runway workers
categories.description: Spaceport ground and flight-deck crews in high-vis pressure suits.

characters.name: Jo Mercer
characters.personality: Direct and watchful; coordinates the deck and makes sure every worker is accounted for.

characters.name: Luis Ortega
characters.personality: Patient with arriving pilots; gives crisp directions and never rushes an approach.

characters.name: Asha Menon
characters.personality: Methodical and dryly funny; gives exact fuel totals and double-checks every coupling.

characters.name: Ben Harlow
characters.personality: Seasoned mechanic; describes faults plainly and usually has a practical fix ready.

characters.name: Nadiya Bell
characters.personality: Energetic and observant; keeps cargo moving while checking restraints and clearances.

characters.name: Kenji Sato
characters.personality: Quiet and precise; reports launch equipment status and catches small problems early.
